target_venue.name: IEEE Access
target_venue.scope: Multidisciplinary applications of AI, Computer Vision, Pattern Recognition, Biometrics, and Human-Machine Systems
target_venue.review_model: Binary Decision (Accept or Reject / Reject and Resubmit)
core_criteria: Comprehensive experimental validation and baseline comparisons
Clarity of exposition, figures, and reproducibility
Ethical compliance and data provenance in facial biometrics

expertise: Academic writing structure and IMRaD hygiene
panel_members.scoring_mandate: Evaluate whether the manuscript provides a sufficient advance over prior work to justify publication in IEEE Access, ensure adherence to IEEE formatting and bibliographic hygiene, and maintain exposition clarity.

expertise: Data leakage prevention in deep feature extraction pipelines
Statistical hypothesis testing (McNemar, DeLong, paired t-test, confidence intervals)
panel_members.scoring_mandate: Rigorously audit the experimental design, dataset split protocols (detecting any potential image vs subject leakage), feature scaling/PCA leakage, and require formal inferential statistics for all claimed empirical gains.

expertise: Facial attribute recognition and demographic classification
Pre-trained model provenance and foundation model transferability
panel_members.scoring_mandate: Evaluate the technical soundness of the facial, emotion, and age representations, scrutinize baseline comparisons against the broader literature, and verify the provenance and validity of upstream pre-trained checkpoints.

expertise: Algorithmic fairness, bias audits, and intersectional demographic disparities
AI ethics, privacy, and responsible biometrics deployment
Computational efficiency, edge inference latency, and parameter footprint
panel_members.scoring_mandate: Scrutinize the ethical framing and algorithmic fairness claims (verifying formal bias metrics), assess subgroup disparities (particularly for vulnerable intersectional cohorts), and audit the real-world deployment viability (latency, memory footprint of 3 ViT backbones).

expertise: Detection of marginal gains overclaimed as breakthroughs
Fallacy detection, confirmation bias, and cherry-picking identification
Critical analysis of multi-domain feature redundancy
panel_members.scoring_mandate: Directly attack the core thesis of the paper: question whether the +0.41% accuracy gain (merely 9 test images) from adding the Age domain is genuinely meaningful or statistical noise, challenge the framing of feature concatenation as a novel framework, and interrogate why Random Forest degrades under tri-domain features.
